items.text: Before replacing your phone, try one controlled test. Put it in a shirt pocket on the same side as the weaker hearing aid, walk outside, and stream audio. If the dropout changes, record the phone position, aid side, model, and result. This does not prove the cause, but it separates a body-blocking pattern from a broader connection problem.

context.summary: Reddit r/HearingAids public educational post from an identified manufacturer account
